name: Jie Tian
bio: I am a master's student in mathematics at the School of Science, Harbin University of Science and Technology. I study nonlinear elliptic partial differential equations, Orlicz growth, rearrangement methods and comparison principles. Alongside mathematics, I explore how AI can assist rigorous human reasoning and how research can become an interactive spatial experience.
principle: A convincing explanation is not the same as a proof.
institution: Harbin University of Science and Technology
